title: Select production research specialist
rationale: The caller selected the production social-media specialist.

title: Run in web-search mode
decision: Capture search snippets instead of opening pages
rationale: No browser is available on this host and the egress proxy blocks page fetches, so browser mode cannot be satisfied. Web-search mode preserves a real external first action.

title: Discard off-domain results
decision: Exclude results not hosted on the platform being swept
rationale: The host treats a domain filter as a ranking hint, so sweeps returned arxiv.org and uspto.gov results. Counting those as platform signal would inflate coverage.

title: Report Reddit absence as load-bearing
decision: Record the Reddit block as a gap that directly weakens the newcomer finding
rationale: Beginner XR questions concentrate on Reddit, so its absence is not a neutral coverage note.
